name: The Looping Summer Time
summary:
The roulette for a grand prize is spinning....

The Looping Summer Time is a visual novel about a group of friends who win a lottery for an all expenses paid vacation to a beautiful island, far away from their hometown.

Excited to take a break from their college lives, they set off for what seems to be the perfect summer getaway. Sun, beaches, laughter, and unforgettable memories await them.

...Welcome to their summer vacation story!
